nodes.description: Three playing cards (Jack, Queen, King of Spades) rendered in pixel art style featuring characters from Assassin's Creed. The Jack shows a character in a long coat and wide-brimmed hat (pirate/colonial assassin aesthetic), the Queen shows a figure mid-air with a weapon (acrobatic assassin), and the King depicts a hooded assassin holding a scroll or weapon with a red banner. Palette uses blue-green and muted tones with white card borders.
nodes.norm_label: collab ac joker card set 1 (assassin's creed)

nodes.label: Collab AC Joker Card Set 2 (Assassin's Creed)
nodes.description: Three playing cards (Jack, Queen, King of Spades) in pixel art style, identical character compositions to collab_AC_1 but with a darker/purple-tinted color palette. The Jack retains the wide-brimmed hat assassin, the Queen the acrobatic airborne figure, and the King the hooded assassin with scroll. Represents the alternate color variant of the Assassin's Creed collaboration joker set.
nodes.norm_label: collab ac joker card set 2 (assassin's creed)

nodes.label: Collab AU Joker Card Set 1 (Among Us)
nodes.description: Three playing cards (Jack, Queen, King of Hearts) in pixel art style featuring characters from Among Us. All three cards depict the iconic crewmate and/or impostor bean-shaped characters with visors. The Jack shows a crewmate, the Queen shows a crewmate in a pose suggesting an impostor with tentacles or equipment, and the King shows a large angry red impostor. Hearts suit is prominent. Colors are bright red, blue, and white against a light card background.
nodes.norm_label: collab au joker card set 1 (among us)

nodes.label: Collab AU Joker Card Set 2 (Among Us)
nodes.description: Three playing cards (Jack, Queen, King of Hearts) in pixel art style, visually near-identical to collab_AU_1 with the same Among Us crewmate/impostor characters. Represents a second variant or foil version of the Among Us collaboration joker set. Color palette and character arrangement mirror the first set closely.
nodes.norm_label: collab au joker card set 2 (among us)

nodes.label: Collab BUG Joker Card Set 1 (Bug Fables / insect theme)
nodes.description: Three playing cards (Jack, Queen, King of Clubs) in pixel art style featuring insect or bug-themed characters, likely from Bug Fables or a similar bug-themed RPG. The Jack shows a blue bug/beetle character, the Queen shows a pink/light-colored bug creature holding something, and the King depicts a large regal bug with a crown and golden decorations. The art style uses soft pastel tones with green and blue hues.
nodes.norm_label: collab bug joker card set 1 (bug fables / insect theme)

nodes.label: Collab BUG Joker Card Set 2 (Bug Fables / insect theme)
nodes.description: Three playing cards (Jack, Queen, King of Clubs) in pixel art style, same insect/bug-themed characters as collab_BUG_1 but rendered in a darker, more muted or monochromatic color scheme — primarily grey and red tones, suggesting a foil/alternate palette variant. The King still wears a crown. Characters maintain the same poses and compositions as the first set.
nodes.norm_label: collab bug joker card set 2 (bug fables / insect theme)
